title: Seed Do-Payment test data for 3 scenarios (success / insufficient / multi-wallet-priority) + identify PES-authorized users and the node each uses
currentStep: Parallel READ-ONLY research: (1) charging wallet model + deduction + wallet-strategy resolver; (2) commerce do-payment endpoint + order saga + node/comm-channel/pricing; (3) essentials stack state + seed mechanism + existing data + env target. Self: PES gate for comm-channels/service-pricing view.
nextStep: Synthesize seed plan; confirm local-vs-cloud target if ambiguous; seed the 3 scenarios; deliver users + nodes table.

scenarios.success: Completed — fundable: wallet balance >= comm-channel price
scenarios.insufficient: Failed + OrderFailureReason.InsufficientFunds — total wallet balance < price
scenarios.multiWalletPriority: Failed + OrderFailureReason.CommChannelPriorityOrderRequired — no single wallet covers the price but multiple together do; user reorders in host-shell DoPaymentPriorityPopup

keyFacts: Do-Payment is NOT PES-gated (no DoPayment key in PES registry). availableActions=[DoPayment,Disable] emitted by commerce AllowedFalconServiceActionsGenerator for Inactive/Expired comm-channels with Visibility + HasConfiguredPricing (PricingType + PriceValue both set). Ref BACKEND-BUGS-REGISTRY BUG-DOPAYMENT.

Real do-payment + wallet-priority flow lives ONLY in host-shell DoPaymentPriorityPopupComponent (apps/host-shell/.../shared-components/do-payment-priority-popup). mgmt-console intentionally omits it (comm-mkt-view.component.ts:249).

FE trigger: { id=commChannelId, accountId, nodeId, target='comm-channel' }. Calls CommChannelPaymentService.doPayment -> orderId; OrderStatusService.getOrderStatus; getVisibleCommChannels(nodeId) for reorder dialog.

6 seeded users, pwd Admin@1234; acc-* on test-tenant-001. Do-payment page reached via host-shell org-hierarchy -> CommChannels & Services (acc.service.view; acc-owner allow, acc-admin explicit-deny, acc-user deny per 21/21 PES gate).

charging TestingChargingController is WhatsApp-sim inspection (read GET wallets/balances/overview), gated by TestingCharging.Enabled. WalletController: get-account-wallets/debit/authorize/reserve/commit/release/transfer.
